covers_spec: INTENT: codex-full-support (frozen 2026-07-05T17:52:45Z) T009 docs/memory refresh; INTENT: omp-native-support (frozen 2026-06-24T05:19:41Z) T009 native OMP export contract

entry_points.summary: Canonical export result dataclass (dest, files, fidelity, warnings); owned by runtime, re-exported from z_harness_cli/adapters/base.py
Collect skills and agents from skills/ and agents/ into a kind-keyed dict; keeps back-compat commands: [] key so pi and export-only drivers do not KeyError
Public alias for expand_includes; base_dir accepted but unused (always resolves relative to repo_root)
Inline <!-- include: path --> markers recursively; skips fenced code blocks; raises on missing fragment or cycle
Compute conventional output path for cursor or codex targets; agy absent (owns its own dual layout)
Require ## Supported, ## Unsupported, ## Notes sections in CAPABILITIES.md
Frozenset of always-on agent IDs (implementer, reviewer, auditor, mr-reviewer, remote-runner); single source of truth imported by agy/windsurf/kiro drivers
Pure helper: given strategy (pointer|curated|full) + enumerated sources, return filtered subset to emit
Read export.strategy from scripts/config.py get (subprocess); falls back to driver-supplied default when config absent
Verify fragment include expansion; ported from scripts/export-common.py cmd_self_test

Emit AGENT .mdc rules to .cursor/rules/ and native SKILL.md files to .cursor/skills/<id>/SKILL.md; write exactly one generated always-apply .cursor/rules/z-harness-skills.mdc index; fidelity=flattened
Replace Agent/Skill/tool-schema call sites with Cursor limitation comment line-by-line
Render one AGENT entry as a Cursor .mdc rule with YAML frontmatter (description, alwaysApply); not used for skills (those are written verbatim)

Emit Codex skills/<id>/SKILL.md files, .codex/agents/<id>.toml custom agents, .codex-plugin/plugin.json, AGENTS.md fallback/reference, and mcp_config.json; validate custom-agent TOML and optional CAPABILITIES.md when present; fidelity=partial
Replace unsupported runtime dispatch call sites with Codex partial-export/runtime-dispatch limitation comment
Render a source skill into Codex's native skills/<id>/SKILL.md plugin layout
Consolidate exported agents into AGENTS.md as a fallback/reference alongside native .codex/agents TOML
Emit all agy surfaces: workflows, rules, skills, flat prompts, manifest, CAPABILITIES.md, README.md; fidelity=high
Render command as Antigravity workflow .md (description frontmatter, 250-char limit, --- escaping)
Render agent as Antigravity rule .md with always_on or model_decision trigger
Render skill as native Antigravity SKILL.md under .agent/skills/<id>/SKILL.md
Generate agy-plugin.yaml export manifest (z-harness convention only; not read by agy natively)
Emit pi agent files, prompts, vendored subagent extension, AGENTS.md index; export-only target; fidelity=high
Map comma-separated frontmatter tools string to pi tool names; returns (pi_tools, dropped)
Return pi-flavored subagent-tool hint for Agent/Skill/tool call sites, or None to keep line
Inject PROMPT_DEFENSE_BLOCK after <!-- PROMPT_DEFENSE_MARKER -->; falls back to after heading; idempotent
Re-export of runtime ExportResult; CLI-layer code imports from here, never from runtime directly
Protocol: delegate to runtime export(), run persona loop from personas/builtin/, merge results; raise RuntimeError on non-empty warnings
Two-stage: cursor runtime export then persona loop from personas/builtin/; RuntimeError on validation errors; fidelity=flattened
Two-stage: codex runtime export then persona loop from personas/builtin/; RuntimeError on validation errors; fidelity=partial
Two-stage: agy runtime export then persona loop from personas/builtin/; RuntimeError on validation errors; fidelity=high
User-facing entry point: refreshes canonical exports/<target>/ mirrors; cursor/codex/agy/omp via runtime CLI, pi and export-only drivers via direct runtime-driver import
Emit native-fidelity OMP .omp/config.yml plus .omp/z-harness package layout (T009): manifest, skills, rules, prompts, agents, profiles; ExportResult.fidelity='native'; no pi line rewrites.
Delegate to OMP runtime export and return gate-driven fidelity; fidelity_tier='native' after T009; four command families are native (z-execute/z-consult/z-gate/z-panel); all others degraded.

invariants: Source of truth is skills/<id>/SKILL.md, agents/, and personas/builtin/; /z-export refreshes canonical exports/<target>/ mirrors sequentially, while runtime drivers still support arbitrary export_root destinations
ExportResult is owned by runtime/drivers/_export_utils.py; z_harness_cli code imports it only via z_harness_cli/adapters/base.py (one-way layering)
All current runtime export() functions share signature: export(repo_root, export_root, *, options=None) -> ExportResult
Non-empty ExportResult.warnings from the runtime export() are raised as RuntimeError by every adapter's export_payload() (legacy hard-gate preserved)
Unsupported constructs (Agent, Skill, AskUserQuestion, TaskCreate, SubagentCreate) are replaced with target-specific HTML comments, never silently dropped

Target-specific exporters validate required artifacts where implemented; adapters surface non-empty runtime warnings as failures instead of silently reporting success. CAPABILITIES.md, when validated, must contain ## Supported, ## Unsupported, ## Notes sections

Cursor and Codex append -skill suffix if a skill ID collides with an agent ID in export output; agy flat prompts use skill- prefix; legacy command/skill collision logic is no longer relevant (commands/ deleted)
output_path_for handles only cursor and codex; agy is intentionally absent (owns its dual layout)
pi is export-only: no adapter, no HostDriver, no --host pi CLI flag; export runs via direct import of runtime.drivers.pi.export
pi has no persona export; persona export (from personas/builtin/) runs only for cursor, codex, and agy, while OMP profiles are rendered by runtime/drivers/omp/export.py

/z-export writes canonical exports/<target>/ mirrors: cursor/codex/agy/OMP via the runtime CLI with --out exports/<target> --force, and pi/windsurf/kiro/cline/copilot via standalone runtime drivers. Codex output is partial-fidelity; OMP output is native-fidelity. CLI --out paths must resolve inside the repo root; use exports/<target> or temp/<target> for ad hoc runs.
/z-export performs no direct file I/O; all writes are delegated to runtime export() and persona_export.py modules
_ALWAYS_ON_AGENTS is defined once in _export_utils.py and imported by every driver that needs it (agy, windsurf, kiro); never redefined per-driver
audit-tarball.sh is the safety gate for packaged artifacts, independent of the export drivers
OMP export emits .omp/config.yml plus .omp/z-harness/ package resources and is not a pi export variant.
OMP ExportResult.fidelity is 'native' after T009; it is synchronized with OmpAdapter.fidelity_tier and COMMAND_CAPABILITY_MATRIX["omp"] via omp_parity_gate.py.
OMP discovery keeps .omp/config.yml skills.enableAgentsProject=false and uses explicit OMP_PLUGIN_ROOT package discovery.

Codex export fidelity is 'partial': native SKILL.md files, .codex/agents custom-agent TOML, .codex-plugin/plugin.json, AGENTS.md fallback/reference, and mcp_config.json are emitted, but CLI runtime command orchestration remains flattened/degraded/blocked.
gotchas: skills/<id>/SKILL.md is the ONLY hand-authored committed source tier — commands/ markdown directory is deleted; enumerate_sources walks skills/*/SKILL.md and keeps a back-compat commands: [] key; cursor export writes verbatim .cursor/skills/<id>/SKILL.md (no transliteration)
Legacy scripts/export-{common,cursor,codex,agy}.py have been deleted; runtime/drivers/<target>/export.py is the only current path
output_path_for intentionally omits agy — the agy exporter owns a dual layout (.agent/ + prompts/) that cannot be expressed as a single path
/z-export uses exports/<target>/ as the canonical mirror destination. --in-place still writes into cwd for live workspace install, and lower-level --out <dest> remains available for ad hoc exports.
inline_includes accepts base_dir for API symmetry but never uses it; resolution is always relative to repo_root (preserved quirk from legacy export-common.py)

Codex exports skills as native skills/<id>/SKILL.md files discovered through .codex-plugin/plugin.json; agents export as .codex/agents/<id>.toml with AGENTS.md as fallback/reference; no per-agent prompt files are emitted

agy _ALWAYS_ON_AGENTS is defined in _export_utils.py and imported by antigravity/export.py (not redefined there); single source of truth covers implementer, reviewer, auditor, mr-reviewer, remote-runner
agy-plugin.yaml is a z-harness convention manifest; Antigravity does not read it natively
Antigravity workflow bodies have an ~12,000 character limit; several z-harness commands exceed it
pi asset files (CAPABILITIES.md, AGENTS.preamble.md, explore.md, extensions/) live in scripts/pi_assets/; resolved __file__-relative for standalone import
pi model tier mapping: haiku -> deepseek-v4-flash, sonnet/opus -> deepseek-v4-pro
pi injects PROMPT_DEFENSE_BLOCK after <!-- PROMPT_DEFENSE_MARKER -->; falls back to after the heading line if no sentinel found

Cursor personas are alwaysApply: true .mdc rules under .cursor/personas/ (no native Cursor persona mechanism); Cursor SKILLS are written verbatim as .cursor/skills/<id>/SKILL.md (native Cursor 2.4+ mechanism, not .mdc transliteration)
z_harness_cli/adapters/base.py re-exports ExportResult as __all__ = ['ExportResult'] so tests that import from base get the runtime type
select_sources and resolve_strategy are used by export-only drivers (windsurf, kiro, cline, copilot) but not by cursor, codex, agy, pi, or OMP, which enumerate all sources unconditionally
scripts/omp-consult.sh is provider-registry compatibility only; native OMP export/dispatch must not call it.

OMP package files are .omp/z-harness/ resources (T009 native): manifest, skills, rules, prompts, agents, profiles. .omp/config.yml is never modified. Four command families are native; others degraded.

Codex custom-agent export is not proof of Codex CLI native subagent dispatch. z_subagent_dispatch still requires Codex primitive evidence plus a CodexDriver.dispatch_native_subagent hook and currently falls back to generic MCP dispatch.

codex_partial_export_contract.status: partial first-class host export; runtime command orchestration not native
codex_partial_export_contract.runtime_boundary: z-execute/z-panel/z-consult/z-gate remain blocked; ordinary commands such as z-plan are degraded until native subagent primitive evidence and a driver hook exist
codex_partial_export_contract.claim_boundary: Codex app/plugin multi_agent evidence and exported custom-agent TOML are not proof of Codex CLI native command orchestration

omp_native_export_contract.status: native first-class host export (T009 complete); not legacy pi export
omp_native_export_contract.ground_truth: Claude Code parity via capabilities-matrix gate; fidelity='native' after T009 for adapter and export; four command families native
omp_native_export_contract.discovery: OMP_PLUGIN_ROOT points to the session/export package root; .omp/config.yml keeps skills.enableAgentsProject=false to suppress root AGENTS autoload
omp_native_export_contract.fidelity: ExportResult.fidelity='native' after T009; synchronized with OmpAdapter.fidelity_tier via omp_parity_gate.py
